evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The compact contrast is deliberately accessible and jargon-light, with no marked technical or playful departure.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: “substrate” and the compressed asset distinction perform an aphoristic, domain-oriented register rather than ordinary conversational phrasing.
The sentence uses flat metacommentary to identify a thesis and its extraction purpose, without audience address or expressive flourish.
